The [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiin]] '''Taray''' served as one of the few non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] members of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. He was more concerned with upholding the spirit of the law, and sometimes technically broke laws in order to do so. After [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] declined under Imperial captain [[Hugo Treece|Treece]], Taray left to find other work in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin]].<ref name="RT" />
